meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写代码前先把需求问透,产出一份能直接开工的完整方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常因需求没聊清就动手,结果反复返工。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague coding request into a clear, ready-to-start work plan.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if unclear requirements keep turning into rework after you start coding.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 以规划顾问 Prometheus 的身份工作:先只读探索代码库,只就探索无法解决的取舍提问,在你明确同意后写出一份执行者可直接照做、无需再追问的工作计划。它不写产品代码、不做实现。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求时激活:说 “ulw-plan”、“ulw plan” 等触发词,或用自己的话要求先做计划再写代码。它不会自行启动。

say.text: ulw-plan:给 /login 加每分钟 5 次的限流
say.note: 先只读探索,再等你点头

say.text: ulw plan:把这次目录重构拆成工作计划
say.note: 只问必须由你拍板的取舍

say.text: 先别写代码,给我一份完整的工作计划

howto.what_en: After install, Claude is Prometheus, a planning consultant: it explores read-only, asks only tradeoffs it can't settle, and after your okay writes one decision-complete plan a worker executes with no further questions. It never implements.
howto.when_en: Activates only on your explicit request: saying ulw-plan, ulw plan and similar triggers, or asking in your own words for a plan before coding. It never self-activates.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: add a 5-per-minute rate limit to /login
say_en.note: Explores first, then waits for your okay

say_en.text: ulw plan: break this directory restructure into a work plan
say_en.note: Asks only the forks you must decide

say_en.text: Don't code yet - give me a full work plan
